description: This is the main activity class 'AdbTestActivity' for an Android application intended to test USB ADB (Android Debug Bridge) device interactions. It manages USB device connections, interfaces, and logging within the app, handling device attachment/detachment events and establishing communication with ADB devices.

classes.name: AdbTestActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing USB ADB device interactions, especially handling device connection, logs, and interaction lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and registers USB device listeners.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by unregistering receivers and releasing interfaces.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Queues a log message to be displayed in the UI.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends text to the existing log, maintaining maximum visible lines.

methods.name: deviceOnline
methods.description: Handles the event when a device is online; initiates a logcat shell command.

methods.name: handleDeviceOnline
methods.description: Processes a device that just came online, logs information, and starts a socket.

methods.name: setAdbInterface
methods.description: Assigns or releases the current USB device and interface, managing connection state.

methods.name: findAdbInterface
methods.description: Locates a specific ADB interface on a given USB device based on interface class/subclass/protocol.
